c1-mat-0009: Jesus was on a long walk to meet John. See where that trip began in Matthew 3:13.
c1-mat-0010: Two cousins met at the edge of the crowd. Matthew 3:14 shows what John did next.
c1-mat-0011: Jesus answered John with calm, clear words. Read them for yourself in Matthew 3:15.
c1-mat-0012: Jesus came up, and that very moment mattered. Look closely at Matthew 3:16 with me.
c1-mrk-0005: Crowds gathered to see John that season. Find where Jesus met him in Mark 1:9.
c1-mrk-0006: Imagine a voice from above, clear and close. Mark 1:11 holds those words for you.
c1-luk-0009: Many people were there that day, and Jesus was among them. Find Him in Luke 3:21.
c1-luk-0010: Everyone near Jesus saw something they would never forget. Turn to Luke 3:22 and see it.
c1-mrk-0007: Picture a seashore early in the day, with two brothers busy at work. Mark 1:16 shows the scene.
c1-mrk-0008: Jesus spoke to the brothers by the shore. Mark 1:17 and Mark 1:18 tell what they chose.
c1-mrk-0009: A bit farther along, another boat sat nearby. Meet the people in it in Mark 1:19.
c1-mrk-0010: Jesus called some men to come near Him. Count along with me in Mark 3:14.
c1-mrk-0011: Jesus spoke to Simon in a way Simon would never forget. Mark 3:16 tells us more.
c1-mrk-0012: These men were chosen for a reason, and Jesus said what it was. Read along in Mark 3:14.
c1-luk-0011: Picture tired men on a dark lake, working until morning. Luke 5:5 shares how the night went.
c1-luk-0012: Partners rushed over to help, and both boats got full. Come see what happened next in Luke 5:7.
c1-luk-0013: A man lay hurt by the side of a lonely road. Luke 10:33 shows who stopped.
c1-luk-0014: Someone knelt down beside the hurt man to help. Peek at Luke 10:34 for what came next.
c1-luk-0015: Out in the open fields, a man counted his flock. Luke 15:4 has the number waiting.
c1-luk-0016: Jesus finished His story with words about heaven. Luke 15:7 says it best.
c1-luk-0017: The younger son was far from home, with empty pockets. Find out where he ended up in Luke 15:15.
c1-luk-0018: A long road led back to a waiting house. Luke 15:20 shows what the father did.
c1-mat-0013: Two builders, two houses, and a coming storm. Open Matthew 7:24 and look at the wise builder's choice.
c1-mat-0014: A farmer tossed seed in every direction. Follow it to Matthew 13:8.
c1-mat-0015: Crowds were coming from all around to see Jesus. Matthew 5:1 shows where He went.
c1-mat-0016: Jesus sat down and began to teach. One of His sayings waits in Matthew 5:8.
c1-mat-0017: Picture people who help others make up after a fight. Jesus speaks about them in Matthew 5:9.
c1-mat-0018: Jesus used an everyday picture to teach a lesson. Find it in Matthew 5:13.
c1-mat-0019: The crowd sat close as Jesus shared one picture after another. Look at Matthew 5:14 together with me.
c1-mat-0020: Jesus gave a reason, and it's right there in the verse. Let's open Matthew 5:16.
c1-mat-0021: Jesus taught His friends how to talk to God. Read Matthew 6:11 and see what we ask.
c1-mat-0022: The next part of that prayer is worth a careful look. Matthew 6:12 is right here.
c1-luk-0019: Jesus came to visit two sisters in their home. See where Mary chose to be in Luke 10:39.
c1-luk-0020: The house was full, and Martha had a lot on her mind. Luke 10:40 tells us why.
c1-luk-0021: In the busy town of Jericho lived a man named Zacchaeus. Meet him in Luke 19:2.
c1-luk-0022: The street was packed, and Zacchaeus couldn't see a thing. Luke 19:3 explains why.
c1-luk-0023: Zacchaeus ran ahead with a plan. Luke 19:4 shows what he did.
c1-luk-0024: Jesus explained why He had come. His own words are in Luke 19:10.
c1-mrk-0013: Parents brought their children to Jesus, and His helpers tried to stop them. Mark 10:14 shows how Jesus felt.
c1-mrk-0014: Jesus held the children close in His arms. Mark 10:16 finishes the moment.
c1-luk-0025: Jesus sent two friends into a village nearby. See what they were to bring in Luke 19:30.
c1-luk-0026: What if someone stopped the two friends and asked questions? Jesus told them what to say in Luke 19:31.
c1-luk-0027: The road filled with people as Jesus rode along. Look at Luke 19:36 and picture the scene.
c1-luk-0028: Some leaders wanted the crowd to be quiet. Jesus answered them in Luke 19:40.
c1-jhn-0016: People kept talking about a tomb and a man raised to life. John 12:17 says his name.
c1-jhn-0017: The crowd ran out to meet Jesus, shouting as He came. John 12:13 has their words.
c1-jhn-0018: So many people came out to meet Jesus that day. John 12:18 tells the reason.
c1-jhn-0019: The Pharisees huddled close and talked among themselves. Read what they said in John 12:19.
c1-luk-0029: A special meal needed getting ready. Luke 22:8 tells who Jesus sent.
c1-luk-0030: Two friends walked into the city, looking for someone. Luke 22:10 gives the clue.
c1-luk-0031: Jesus held the bread and spoke to His friends. Read His words in Luke 22:19.
c1-luk-0032: Supper was over, and Jesus lifted the cup. Luke 22:20 tells what He said.
c1-mat-0023: The meal was done, and Jesus walked out into the night. Matthew 26:36 shows where He went.
c1-mat-0024: Jesus felt very sad that night. Matthew 26:38 tells what He asked of His friends.
c1-mat-0025: Jesus came back to His friends a second time. Find out how He found them in Matthew 26:43.
c1-mat-0026: Jesus went on a few steps alone. His prayer is in Matthew 26:39.
c1-act-0001: Before Jesus went up, He told His friends what was coming. Acts 1:8 has His words.
c1-act-0002: The friends stood looking up as Jesus rose. Read Acts 1:9 and see what happened.
c1-act-0003: Two men in white came near the staring friends. Their message is waiting in Acts 1:11.
c1-act-0004: The believers were together in one room on a big feast day. Turn to Acts 2:2 and picture it.
c1-act-0005: Something amazing appeared over each person in the room. Take a look at Acts 2:3.
c1-act-0006: The crowd asked Peter a big question. His answer is in Acts 2:38.
c1-act-0007: Peter finished speaking, and many people believed. Acts 2:41 gives the count.
c1-act-0008: The first believers spent their days together. Acts 2:42 shows what filled them.
c1-act-0009: A man sat by the temple gate every single day. Can you spot the gate's name in Acts 3:10?
c1-act-0010: Friends carried the man to the gate each day. Acts 3:2 tells how long it had been.
c1-act-0011: Peter and John stopped in front of the man. Peter speaks first in Acts 3:4.
c1-act-0012: Peter had no money to give, but he had something else. Acts 3:6 shares his words.
c1-act-0013: Strong feet for the very first time! See what the man did in Acts 3:8.
c1-act-0014: It was the night before Herod's plan, deep inside a prison. Acts 12:6 shows Peter's night.
c1-act-0015: In the dark prison cell, someone woke Peter up. Come meet the visitor in Acts 12:7.
c1-act-0016: Friends were inside a house, and there was a knock at the gate. Open Acts 12:13 to see who came.
c1-act-0017: Saul was on the road, almost to Damascus. Read Acts 9:3 and see what happened.
c1-act-0018: Everything changed for Saul in one moment on that road. Acts 9:4 tells what he did.
c1-act-0019: Saul was led by the hand into the city. Acts 9:9 gives the number of days.
c1-act-0020: God had a job for someone in Damascus. Find out who it was in Acts 9:10.
c1-act-0021: A man came and put his hands on Saul. Look at Acts 9:18 to see what happened.
c1-act-0022: It was midnight in a dark jail for Paul and Silas. Read Acts 16:25 and picture that night.
c1-act-0023: Doors flew open and chains fell off! Let's find out why in Acts 16:26.
c1-act-0024: The jailer asked the biggest question of his life. Acts 16:31 has the answer.
c1-rom-0001: Paul wrote this line to the church in Rome. Read Romans 3:23 with me.
c1-rom-0002: Here's a verse to read nice and close. Turn to Romans 3:24.
c1-rom-0003: Paul wrote about the right time. See who Romans 5:6 talks about.
c1-rom-0004: Think about Jesus and the cross. Romans 5:8 is the place to look.
c1-rom-0005: Paul ends this verse by talking about a gift. Romans 6:23 tells what it is.
c1-rom-0006: Believing and saying go together in this verse. Let's read Romans 10:10.
c1-rom-0007: Anyone can call out to God. Romans 10:13 finishes the thought.
c1-rom-0008: Faith has to start somewhere. Romans 10:17 explains where.
c1-eph-0001: Paul told the church in Ephesus something about work. Ephesians 2:9 says more.
c1-eph-0002: This verse talks about who we are to God. Open Ephesians 2:10 and see.
c1-eph-0003: Think of how you treat your friends and family. Ephesians 4:32 gives three words to remember.
c1-eph-0004: This verse speaks right to kids and their families. Give Ephesians 6:1 a careful read.
c1-eph-0005: Moms and dads matter to God. Ephesians 6:2 and Ephesians 6:3 tell what comes with honoring them.
c1-eph-0006: Picture a helmet and a sword, ready for the day. Ephesians 6:17 tells what the sword really is.
c1-php-0001: Paul knew what worry feels like. Philippians 4:6 has his words for us.
c1-php-0002: Paul wrote this from a hard place. Philippians 4:13 is a verse to keep close.
c1-psa-0001: Psalm 1 paints a picture you can almost see. Look at Psalm 1:3.
c1-psa-0002: David looked up and wondered at all God made. Psalm 8:3 shows what he saw.
c1-psa-0003: Step outside and look up high. Psalm 19:1 says what the heavens tell us.
c1-psa-0004: Many people can say Psalm 23 from memory. Begin with Psalm 23:1.
c1-psa-0005: David ends Psalm 23 looking far ahead. Read Psalm 23:6 to see what follows him.
c1-psa-0006: God speaks right to His people in this psalm. His words wait for you in Psalm 46:10.
c1-psa-0007: Picture walking up to the gates of God's house. Psalm 100:4 tells how to come in.
c1-psa-0008: Psalm 119 is the longest chapter in the whole Bible. Find your spot at Psalm 119:111.
c1-pro-0001: Proverbs opens with a big idea. Read Proverbs 1:7.
c1-pro-0002: Proverbs 1:8 has two parts that go together. Read them both.
c1-pro-0003: Trusting God takes your whole self. Proverbs 3:5 says more about it.
c1-pro-0004: This verse follows the one about trusting God. Read Proverbs 3:6.
c1-pro-0005: Firstfruits are the first crops of the year. Proverbs 3:9 names one more way to honor God.
c1-pro-0006: Think about a time someone spoke to you softly. Proverbs 15:1 talks about moments like that.
c1-pro-0007: Think of your best friend for a moment. Then read Proverbs 17:17.
c1-pro-0008: Picture a child growing up, year after year. Proverbs 22:6 tells what happens when he is old.
c1-dan-0002: Daniel worked for a powerful king. Discover what set him apart in Daniel 6:3.
c1-dan-0003: Some men talked the king into a new rule. Daniel 6:7 tells how long it would last.
c1-dan-0004: Daniel went home to his upstairs room with its open window. Daniel 6:10 shows what he did that day.
c1-dan-0005: Jealous men kept an eye on Daniel, hoping to find trouble. Daniel 6:4 tells what they found.
c1-dan-0006: The king felt awful as Daniel was led to the den. Daniel 6:16 has his words.
c1-dan-0007: Back at the palace, the king had a very long night. Daniel 6:18 lets us peek inside.
c1-dan-0008: The king sent a new rule to every land. Daniel 6:26 shares what he wrote.
c1-dan-0009: King Nebuchadnezzar built something huge and shiny. Daniel 3:1 tells where it stood.
c1-dan-0010: Horns, harps, and pipes all began to play. Everyone got an order in Daniel 3:5.
c1-dan-0011: The king walked right up to the furnace door and called out. Notice what he called out in Daniel 3:26.
c1-dan-0012: Three young men stood before an angry king. Daniel 3:17 holds their brave reply.
c1-dan-0013: The king was so angry his face changed. Daniel 3:19 tells how hot he made the furnace.
c1-dan-0014: The king peeked into the furnace and could not believe his eyes. Look with him in Daniel 3:25.
c1-dan-0015: The officials crowded around the three young men. See it through their eyes in Daniel 3:27.
c1-dan-0016: The king praised their God out loud. See what he did next in Daniel 3:30.
c1-bib-0001: Think about how the Bible is put in order. Take a peek at John 1:1 with me.
c1-bib-0002: Some books in the Bible travel together as a set. Open John 1:17 and think about it.
c1-bib-0003: Four books tell about Jesus' life on earth. Mark 1:1 is where one of them starts.
c1-bib-0004: John's book wraps up with a big thought. John 21:25 sits at the very end.
c1-bib-0005: In Luke 20:42, Jesus talks about a book He knew well. Have a look there.
c1-bib-0006: Paul had people in Rome on his mind. Romans 1:7 shows who.
c1-bib-0007: After rising, Jesus walked and talked with two friends. Walk along with them in Luke 24:27.
c1-bib-0008: Exodus closes with a big moment at God's tent. Read Exodus 40:34, then think about what comes after.
c1-dan-0001: Morning came, and Daniel called up from the den. Daniel 6:22 has what he told the king.
